items.title: Obsidian Vault Architectures
items.summary: 本スライドは、ObsidianのVault設計を、Ideaverse、PARA、kepano、Zettelkastenを軸に、LifeOS、Bramses、JG Method、CyanVoxel、Starter Templates、Shimmering Obsidianまで比較する技術リファレンスである。各方式を方法論、公開Vault、操作レイヤーとして区別し、フォルダとリンク、知識形成と行動管理、最小構成と構造化の観点から整理する。さらに、技術調査・執筆・案件管理への応用と、PARAの活動分類にIdeaverseのMOCを組み合わせたHybrid Vault案を示す。唯一の最適解ではなく、再発見、日常運用、保守できる設定範囲に応じ、単純な構成から段階的に育てることを提案する。

items.title: Obsidian Vault Architectures
items.summary: This slide deck is a technical reference that compares approaches to Obsidian vault design, centered on Ideaverse, PARA, kepano, and Zettelkasten, while also covering LifeOS, Bramses, JG Method, CyanVoxel, Starter Templates, and Shimmering Obsidian. It distinguishes between methodologies, public vaults, and operational layers, organizing them through the lenses of folders versus links, knowledge development versus action management, and minimal versus structured setups. It also presents applications for technical research, writing, and project management, along with a Hybrid Vault proposal that combines PARA’s activity-based classification with Ideaverse’s MOCs. Rather than claiming a single best solution, it recommends starting simple and expanding gradually according to retrieval paths, daily workflows, and the level of configuration one can realistically maintain.
